Boris Kravchenko  
Email: bkravchenko@adverve.io | Phone: +91 9876543210 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/bkravchenko | Location: Bengaluru, India  

Professional Experience  
As a Staff Frontend Engineer at AdVerve Interactive, I specialize in building scalable, high-performance interfaces for ad-tech platforms. Over the past 13 years, I’ve evolved from a junior developer to a principal architect, focusing on user-centric design and system reliability. At ClickTrack Solutions, I led the migration of their analytics dashboard to Next.js microfrontends, enabling real-time data visualization across 15+ client brands. This required designing a modular architecture that reduced load times by 40% and improved maintainability. Previously, at MediaLift Technologies, I optimized React-based ad targeting interfaces, implementing lazy loading and code splitting to cut bundle sizes by 30% while maintaining sub-200ms response times. My work there also involved integrating REST APIs with backend services, ensuring consistent data flow across 10+ ad campaigns. Early in my career, I built responsive campaign dashboards at a local ad agency, laying the foundation for my focus on performance and accessibility.  

Technical Skills  
JavaScript underpins all my frontend work, with ownership of critical components in React applications that handle millions of impressions daily. I’ve architected TypeScript-based systems at scale, ensuring type safety in large codebases while mentoring junior developers. Next.js is central to my identity, having used it to create microfrontends that support real-time analytics for ad campaigns. Node.js has been integral to backend services, particularly in integrating with REST APIs for ad data retrieval. Web performance optimization is a priority, with measurable results from implementing server-side rendering and caching strategies. Web accessibility is a non-negotiable standard, ensuring all interfaces meet WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Webpack and Vite are part of my regular workflow, used to streamline build processes and improve development speed. REST API design is a core competency, with experience in defining and maintaining APIs that power ad targeting and reporting tools.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Moscow State University (2012)  

Projects  
At ClickTrack Solutions, I spearheaded the development of a Next.js-based analytics platform, splitting the monolithic dashboard into microfrontends to enhance scalability. This allowed teams to deploy features independently, reducing deployment time by 25%. At MediaLift, I refactored legacy React code into a modular architecture, improving code reuse and reducing technical debt. I also led the implementation of Webpack 5 for asset optimization, which lowered bundle sizes by 20%.

AWS Certified Solutions Architect (2021) | Google Cloud Professional Developer (2020)

English (fluent), Russian (native)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as AdTech Innovator of the Year (2022) for contributions to real-time analytics platforms. Received a company-wide award for optimizing ad campaign dashboards, achieving a 35% improvement in user engagement metrics.
